summary: Clough Global Equity Fund (GLQ) filed an 8-K to disclose the annual renewal of its open-market share repurchase program. The Board authorized the repurchase of up to 5% of outstanding common shares through June 30, 2027. The program, originally approved in June 2023, is designed to enhance shareholder value by buying shares at discounts to net asset value. Since inception through May 30, 2026, GLQ repurchased 386,500 shares. Repurchases are discretionary, subject to market conditions and regulatory limits. No adviser or deal advisor is named. Watch for ongoing NAV discount arbitrage and periodic disclosure of repurchase activity.
